integrity: The proof reduces the ordered data cone exactly to simplex vertices. All finite coefficient claims are independently reconstructed from the defining moment equations using exact rational arithmetic, and the n=12 coefficients are cross-checked against a published full-text table.
scientific_limitations: The cumulative-weight theorem holds for every closed Newton-Cotes order, but the explicit order classification in this finding is only through n=13. The result concerns bounded nondecreasing sampled values and range preservation, not arbitrary-data noise amplification or an infinite-order sign pattern.
title: The first monotone-range failure of closed Newton–Cotes occurs at twelve panels
